{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:Tutorial2026Icon.png]] |-|Full Icon = [[File:TutorialBanner.png]] |map = [[Tutorial]] |waves = 3 |rewards = {{Coins|400}} & {{Exp|200}} |chapter = TDS: Boot Camp |previous_mission = [[Welcome Recruit]] |next_mission = [[Live Fire]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Learn to place and upgrade Scout and Sniper, then hold off a mixed enemy wave.|In-game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Boot Camp''' is the first mission for the tutorial chapter of the [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The loadout for this map is set to be the [[Scout]] initially, with the [[Sniper]] being given on Wave 2. Sell cost of all towers is also 100% of their total price. Base health here is replaced by a progress bar and [[Skills]] are disabled. ==Rewards== '''Boot Camp''' gives a one time reward of {{Coins|400}} and {{Exp|200}}. Any additional triumphs only reward {{Exp|0}}. ===Badges=== There is also one [[badges|badge]] which can be obtained when playing on this mission. It is: {{Badge |title = Welcome to TDS! |description = You completed the tutorial!
